title: The Infinite Hotel Paradox - Jeff Dekofsky
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】無限酒店悖論——傑夫·德科夫斯基（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In the 1920's, the German mathematician David Hilbert
cues.en: In the 1920's, the German mathematician David Hilbert
cues.zh: 在1920年時期， 德國數學家大衛‧希爾伯特

cues.text: devised a famous thought experiment to show us just how hard it is
cues.en: devised a famous thought experiment to show us just how hard it is
cues.zh: 設計了一個聞名的思考實驗 向世人展示要了解「無限」的概念

cues.text: to wrap our minds around the concept of infinity.
cues.en: to wrap our minds around the concept of infinity.
cues.zh: 向世人展示要了解「無限」的概念 究竟有多麼困難。

cues.text: Imagine a hotel with an infinite number of rooms and a very hardworking night manager.
cues.en: Imagine a hotel with an infinite number of rooms and a very hardworking night manager.
cues.zh: 試想一間擁有無限多間客房的旅館 和一名非常努力工作的夜班經理。

cues.text: One night, the Infinite Hotel is completely full, totally booked up with an infinite number of guests.
cues.en: One night, the Infinite Hotel is completely full, totally booked up with an infinite number of guests.
cues.zh: 有一晚，這間旅館的房間均已客滿 入住了無限名房客。

cues.text: A man walks into the hotel and asks for a room.
cues.en: A man walks into the hotel and asks for a room.
cues.zh: 入住了無限名房客。 一個男人走進了旅館， 想要入住 與其拒絕他，

cues.text: Rather than turn him down, the night manager decides to make room for him.
cues.en: Rather than turn him down, the night manager decides to make room for him.
cues.zh: 與其拒絕他， 這名夜班經理決定為他騰出一間空房。

cues.text: How?
cues.en: How?
cues.zh: 怎麼做呢？ 很簡單，經理先將原先入住1號房的客人

cues.text: Easy, he asks the guest in room number 1 to move to room 2,
cues.en: Easy, he asks the guest in room number 1 to move to room 2,
cues.zh: 很簡單，經理先將原先入住1號房的客人 安置至2號房 將原先入住2號房的客人安置至3號房，

cues.text: the guest in room 2 to move to room 3, and so on.
cues.en: the guest in room 2 to move to room 3, and so on.
cues.zh: 將原先入住2號房的客人安置至3號房， 依此類推。

cues.text: Every guest moves from room number "n" to room number "n+1".
cues.en: Every guest moves from room number "n" to room number "n+1".
cues.zh: n號房間原有的客人 皆安置到n+1號房間。

cues.text: Since there are an infinite number of rooms, there is a new room for each existing guest.
cues.en: Since there are an infinite number of rooms, there is a new room for each existing guest.
cues.zh: 由於旅館內有無限多個房間， 每一位既有的房客都能夠搬到新的房間，

cues.text: This leaves room 1 open for the new customer.
cues.en: This leaves room 1 open for the new customer.
cues.zh: 於是新的客人便得以入住1號房。

cues.text: The process can be repeated for any finite number of new guests.
cues.en: The process can be repeated for any finite number of new guests.
cues.zh: 於是新的客人便得以入住1號房。 這個過程可不斷重複， 只要新房客的數目是有限可數的。

cues.text: If, say, a tour bus unloads 40 new people looking for rooms,
cues.en: If, say, a tour bus unloads 40 new people looking for rooms,
cues.zh: 只要新房客的數目是有限可數的。 假如一輛遊覽車駛進旅館 車上下來了40人都想入住

cues.text: then every existing guest just moves from room number "n" to room number "n+40",
cues.en: then every existing guest just moves from room number "n" to room number "n+40",
cues.zh: 車上下來了40人都想入住 那麼每一位既有的房客 只要從原先入住的n號房 搬到n+40號房

cues.text: thus, opening up the first 40 rooms.
cues.en: thus, opening up the first 40 rooms.
cues.zh: 搬到n+40號房 就能將前40間房都空出來給新客人。

cues.text: But now an infinitely large bus with a countably infinite number of passengers
cues.en: But now an infinitely large bus with a countably infinite number of passengers
cues.zh: 但假如有一輛無限大的遊覽車 載滿了無限多名的乘客

cues.text: pulls up to rent rooms.
cues.en: pulls up to rent rooms.
cues.zh: 停進旅館要入住

cues.text: countably infinite is the key.
cues.en: countably infinite is the key.
cues.zh: 「可數無限」便成了關鍵。

cues.text: Now, the infinite bus of infinite passengers perplexes the night manager at first,
cues.en: Now, the infinite bus of infinite passengers perplexes the night manager at first,
cues.zh: 這輛載滿無限多名乘客的無限大遊覽車 起初讓夜班經理相當苦惱

cues.text: but he realizes there's a way to place each new person.
cues.en: but he realizes there's a way to place each new person.
cues.zh: 起初讓夜班經理相當苦惱 幸好他後來還是找到了 能夠安頓每個新房客的方法。

cues.text: He asks the guest in room 1 to move to room 2.
cues.en: He asks the guest in room 1 to move to room 2.
cues.zh: 能夠安頓每個新房客的方法。 他將原先入住1號房的客人 安置於2號房；

cues.text: He then asks the guest in room 2 to move to room 4,
cues.en: He then asks the guest in room 2 to move to room 4,
cues.zh: 再將2號房的客人 安置於4號房；

cues.text: the guest in room 3 to move to room 6, and so on.
cues.en: the guest in room 3 to move to room 6, and so on.
cues.zh: 將3號房的客人 安置於6號房； 依此類推。

cues.text: Each current guest moves from room number "n" to room number "2n" --
cues.en: Each current guest moves from room number "n" to room number "2n" --
cues.zh: 每一位既有的房客都從原先入住的n號房 搬到2n號房

cues.text: filling up only the infinite even-numbered rooms.
cues.en: filling up only the infinite even-numbered rooms.
cues.zh: 便只有無限間數的雙號房會有人住

cues.text: By doing this, he has now emptied all of the infinitely many odd-numbered rooms,
cues.en: By doing this, he has now emptied all of the infinitely many odd-numbered rooms,
cues.zh: 便只有無限間數的雙號房會有人住 如此一來，旅館中 無限多間的單號房都是空的了

cues.text: which are then taken by the people filing off the infinite bus.
cues.en: which are then taken by the people filing off the infinite bus.
cues.zh: 無限多間的單號房都是空的了 而無限大的遊覽車上所乘載的無限多名乘客 便可入住

cues.text: Everyone's happy and the hotel's business is booming more than ever.
cues.en: Everyone's happy and the hotel's business is booming more than ever.
cues.zh: 這不僅是皆大歡喜的結果 旅館的生意也越發興隆了。

cues.text: Well, actually, it is booming exactly the same amount as ever,
cues.en: Well, actually, it is booming exactly the same amount as ever,
cues.zh: 不過實際上，旅館的生意 其實和先前相比沒有任何變化

cues.text: banking an infinite number of dollars a night.
cues.en: banking an infinite number of dollars a night.
cues.zh: 每一晚都賺進無限可數的利潤。

cues.text: Word spreads about this incredible hotel.
cues.en: Word spreads about this incredible hotel.
cues.zh: 這間不可思議的旅館名氣越來越響亮

cues.text: People pour in from far and wide.
cues.en: People pour in from far and wide.
cues.zh: 人們從各地蜂擁而至

cues.text: One night, the unthinkable happens.
cues.en: One night, the unthinkable happens.
cues.zh: 有一晚，意想不到的事發生了

cues.text: The night manager looks outside and sees an infinite line of infinitely large buses,
cues.en: The night manager looks outside and sees an infinite line of infinitely large buses,
cues.zh: 夜班經理向外頭一看 發現有無限多輛大巴士 正在旅館前大排長龍

cues.text: each with a countably infinite number of passengers.
cues.en: each with a countably infinite number of passengers.
cues.zh: 正在旅館前大排長龍 每輛巴士上都載滿了無限可數的乘客。

cues.text: What can he do?
cues.en: What can he do?
cues.zh: 每輛巴士上都載滿了無限可數的乘客。 他該怎麼辦呢？

cues.text: If he cannot find rooms for them, the hotel will lose out on an infinite amount of money,
cues.en: If he cannot find rooms for them, the hotel will lose out on an infinite amount of money,
cues.zh: 如果他無法為這些人安排房間 旅館便將損失 無限大的一筆收入

cues.text: and he will surely lose his job.
cues.en: and he will surely lose his job.
cues.zh: 無限大的一筆收入 他也一定會丟了飯碗。

cues.text: Luckily, he remembers that around the year 300 B.C.E.,
cues.en: Luckily, he remembers that around the year 300 B.C.E.,
cues.zh: 還好，他還記得 大約在西元前300年時

cues.text: Euclid proved that there is an infinite quantity of prime numbers.
cues.en: Euclid proved that there is an infinite quantity of prime numbers.
cues.zh: 大約在西元前300年時 歐幾裡得證明瞭一件事： 質數是無限的。

cues.text: So, to accomplish this seemingly impossible task of finding infinite beds for infinite buses
cues.en: So, to accomplish this seemingly impossible task of finding infinite beds for infinite buses
cues.zh: 於是為了達成這項看似不可能的任務 找到無限多的床位 給乘坐在無限多輛巴士上的

cues.text: of infinite weary travelers, the night manager assigns every current guest
cues.en: of infinite weary travelers, the night manager assigns every current guest
cues.zh: 的無限多名疲憊旅客 夜班經理將每一位既有房客 都安置在第一個質數，2，

cues.text: to the first prime number, 2, raised to the power of their current room number.
cues.en: to the first prime number, 2, raised to the power of their current room number.
cues.zh: 都安置在第一個質數，2， 再依該房客原本入住的房間號碼次方的房間號碼。

cues.text: So, the current occupant of room number 7 goes to room number 2^7,
cues.en: So, the current occupant of room number 7 goes to room number 2^7,
cues.zh: 再依該房客原本入住的房間號碼次方的房間號碼。 於是，原本入住7號房的客人 就會改住（2的7次方）號房

cues.text: which is room 128.
cues.en: which is room 128.
cues.zh: 就會改住（2的7次方）號房 也就是第128號房。

cues.text: The night manager then takes the people on the first of the infinite buses
cues.en: The night manager then takes the people on the first of the infinite buses
cues.zh: 接著，夜班經理將無限多輛巴士中 第一輛巴士上的所有乘客

cues.text: and assigns them to the room number of the next prime, 3,
cues.en: and assigns them to the room number of the next prime, 3,
cues.zh: 第一輛巴士上的所有乘客 都安排在下一個質數3 再依每一名乘客在巴士上的座號次方

cues.text: raised to the power of their seat number on the bus.
cues.en: raised to the power of their seat number on the bus.
cues.zh: 再依每一名乘客在巴士上的座號次方 所對應的房號。

cues.text: So, the person in seat number 7 on the first bus
cues.en: So, the person in seat number 7 on the first bus
cues.zh: 所對應的房號。 如此一來，第一輛巴士上坐在7號座位的客人

cues.text: goes to room number 3^7 or room number 2,187.
cues.en: goes to room number 3^7 or room number 2,187.
cues.zh: 如此一來，第一輛巴士上坐在7號座位的客人 便會入住（3的7次方）號房 也就是2187號房。

cues.text: This continues for all of the first bus.
cues.en: This continues for all of the first bus.
cues.zh: 也就是2187號房。 第一輛巴士上的客人皆經此安排。

cues.text: The passengers on the second bus are assigned powers of the next prime, 5.
cues.en: The passengers on the second bus are assigned powers of the next prime, 5.
cues.zh: 第一輛巴士上的客人皆經此安排。 第二輛巴士上的客人 所各自入住的房號則是下一個質數5的座號次方

cues.text: The following bus, powers of 7.
cues.en: The following bus, powers of 7.

cues.text: Each bus follows: powers of 11, powers of 13, powers of 17, etc.
cues.en: Each bus follows: powers of 11, powers of 13, powers of 17, etc.
cues.zh: 依序排列： 11的次方、 13的次方、 17的次方等等。

cues.text: Since each of these numbers only has 1 and the natural number powers
cues.en: Since each of these numbers only has 1 and the natural number powers
cues.zh: 由於這些數字 只有1和數字本身的自然數次方

cues.text: of their prime number base as factors, there are no overlapping room numbers.
cues.en: of their prime number base as factors, there are no overlapping room numbers.

cues.text: All the buses' passengers fan out into rooms using unique room-assignment schemes
cues.en: All the buses' passengers fan out into rooms using unique room-assignment schemes
cues.zh: 所有的客人便遵循這從質數發展出來的 獨特房間安排方式

cues.text: based on unique prime numbers.
cues.en: based on unique prime numbers.
cues.zh: 各自散開進入他們的房間。

cues.text: In this way, the night manager can accommodate every passenger on every bus.
cues.en: In this way, the night manager can accommodate every passenger on every bus.
cues.zh: 如此一來，夜班經理便能將 每一輛巴士上的每一位客人都安置妥當。

cues.text: Although, there will be many rooms that go unfilled, like room 6,
cues.en: Although, there will be many rooms that go unfilled, like room 6,

cues.en: since 6 is not a power of any prime number.

cues.text: Luckily, his bosses weren't very good in math, so his job is safe.
cues.en: Luckily, his bosses weren't very good in math, so his job is safe.
cues.zh: 還好，夜班經理的老闆們並沒有很會算數學 他也因此保住了他的工作。

cues.text: The night manager's strategies are only possible because while the Infinite Hotel is certainly a logistical nightmare,

cues.zh: 這位夜班經理所想出的策略之所以可行 是因為當這間無限旅館 雖然從後勤上來講像是一場噩夢 卻也只處理無限的最低層級

cues.en: these structured strategies would no longer be possible as we have no way to systematically include every number.

cues.en: the scenarios faced by the ever-diligent and maybe too hospitable night manager
